observations.behavior: Adds a new retryable error category to the Gladly warehouse source.
observations.code_quote: return {"Read timed out", "Gladly returned no report", "Gladly API error (retryable)"}
observations.posthog_connection: This change expands the set of errors classified as transient and recoverable by Temporal's activity retry. This could prevent transient API errors (429, 5xx) from being treated as permanent failures or tracked exceptions, allowing the warehouse ingestion to recover automatically without manual intervention. This relies on the assumption that the Gladly client-side retry has failed
